verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline, subhead and legal text in one tidy block and keeps the shoe in its peach circle. But the Shop Sale button sits to the left of the headline, so you read the call to action first. The 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow (the small label above the headline in the original) has dropped below the subhead. There is a large dead gap in the middle-right, and the legal line is unreadably tiny. B breaks the design into scattered pieces: the eyebrow is top-left, 'Every mixed case.' floats top-centre away from '20% off', and the button is stranded top-right. The legal text is microscopic, and the peach circle is cut off and orphaned in the bottom-right corner with no link to the shoe, so nothing reads as a group.
